name: Creed Akiba
source:
Creed is something of a scary looking 22 year old. As [url=/c69554]Robin[/url]'s little brother, Creed starts living with him in order to start his life as an alchemist--as terrible as he may be. Creed appears to be cold, but happens to be afraid of everything--especially animal-shaped lanterns.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/paper-roses]itch.io[/url]]
